hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook backed by Euler lending vaults. In beforeSwap, the hook takes full control of swap execution: it computes quotes against a configurable bonding curve, deposits input tokens into the counterparty's Euler vault, and withdraws output tokens from the other vault, returning a BeforeSwapDelta to settle accounting with the pool manager. Standard Uniswap concentrated liquidity positions are explicitly blocked.
